decisions.reason: Because it builds on established coolant offerings and no shortfall has emerged after two years, aspirations are likely met and slack supports keeping it.
Its fit with existing coolant management capabilities and continued market presence without reported shortfall justify keeping it under slack.
Although the line has several models, no performance shortfall is reported and its engineering/customer fit justifies retention.
It complements the chip conveyor range and, with no signs of falling below aspirations, slack allows continued evaluation.
Close to the core conveyor business and without negative results, it is retained as part of the firm's broad product strategy.
